title: —CREDO UT VOS SANGUINARIUS MENDAX ESTIS, said Cranly, QUIA FACIES VOSTRA MONSTRAT UT VOS IN DAMNO MALO HUMORE ESTIS
html_source:
Latin,
I believe that you are a bloody liar,… because your face shows you are in a damned bad humor.

anchor.text: —CREDO UT VOS SANGUINARIUS MENDAX ESTIS, said Cranly, QUIA FACIES VOSTRA MONSTRAT UT VOS IN DAMNO MALO HUMORE ESTIS
anchor.prefix:
ger in his voice brought Cranly’s eyes back from a calm survey of the walls of the hall.

 —Are you annoyed? he asked.

 —No, answered Stephen.

 —Are you in bad humour?

 —No.

 —
anchor.suffix:
.

 Moynihan, on his way to the table, said in Stephen’s ear:

 —MacCann is in tiptop form. Ready to shed the last drop. Brand new world. No stimulants and votes for the bitches.
anchor.canonical_text: Credo ut vos sanguinarius mendax estis, said Cranly, quia facies vostra monstrat ut vos in damno malo humore estis
